The evidence is in full agreement on the core fact.

All non-irrelevant documents support the same key claim: Russia is the biggest country in Europe by population. Documents that focus on the EU (d3, d4) specify Germany as the most populous EU member, which is complementary and does not conflict with Russia's overall European lead. The provided population figures from different sources and years are consistent.

Russia is the biggest country in Europe by population, with an estimated population of approximately 144.8 million people as of 2025 [d1]. Multiple sources confirm Russia has the largest population among European countries [d2, d6, d7, d9]. Within the European Union, Germany is the most populous member state [d3, d4], but this does not contradict Russia's overall lead in Europe.
